name: ECA
recent: ECA 正在推进一项私下配售，并已获得 Bursa Securities 批准将实施期限延长 6 个月至 2027 年 5 月 13 日。公司在 2026 年 8 月 20 日的特别股东大会上通过了设立员工认股权计划（ESOS）及向董事和首席执行官分配期权的决议。最新季度（截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日）营收同比大幅增长，但净利润环比有所下降。
notable: Bursa Securities granted ECA a 6-month extension until 13 May 2027 to implement its private placement.。
Shareholders approved the establishment of an ESOS of up to 15% of issued shares and the allocation of ESOS options to eligible directors and the CEO at an EGM.。
risks: The private placement remains pending implementation and may dilute existing shareholders' equity upon completion.。
The ESOS of up to 15% of issued shares could dilute existing shareholders if options are exercised.。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日的季度，营收为 MYR 11.798 million，同比增长 111.1%，环比增长 14.2%；净利润为 MYR 1.474 million，环比下降 14.8%，净利率从上一季度的 16.7% 降至 12.5%。

recent_en: ECA is proceeding with a private placement and has obtained Bursa Securities' approval for a 6-month extension until 13 May 2027 to implement it. The company passed resolutions at its EGM on 20 August 2026 to establish an Employees' Share Option Scheme (ESOS) and allocate options to directors and the CEO. In the latest quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue grew strongly year-on-year, while net profit declined quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: Bursa Securities granted ECA a 6-month extension until 13 May 2027 to implement its private placement.
Shareholders approved the establishment of an ESOS of up to 15% of issued shares and the allocation of ESOS options to eligible directors and the CEO at an EGM.
risks_en: The private placement remains pending implementation and may dilute existing shareholders' equity upon completion.
The ESOS of up to 15% of issued shares could dilute existing shareholders if options are exercised.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 11.798 million, up 111.1% year-on-year and 14.2% quarter-on-quarter; net income was MYR 1.474 million, down 14.8% quarter-on-quarter, with net margin declining to 12.5% from 16.7% in the prior quarter.
